WORKLOG task 0 (design_studio_changes, Studio Designer file of Theresa Lindqvist). frozen_time 2026-10-06 10:40:00 MDT.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5, 5]}. Assignment: design_ext_option_deposit_due (root) 6, design_ext_change_order_fee 6, design_ext_studio_consult_fee 5, design_ext_error_goodwill_credit 5.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed: four extended policies and four task tools (record_change_order_fee_50efc86e, grant_goodwill_credit_33ff7b41, book_studio_consult_fee_3108e630, pay_option_deposit_3846be30); events design_change_order_recorded, design_credit_granted (builder goodwill), design_option_added (consultation fee lines only), design_deposit_paid. Reserved headroom for task 1 (draw: 2 prerequisites, factors [4,5,5]): package changes and the package fee/allowance replacement, buyer removal of option lines and their removal credit, design credit application, returned-payment and card fee lines, cancellation refunds and forfeitures of option deposits. None of these is touched here.

[Why a good test] The customer asks one thing: pay the option deposit she owes. The correct figure (8443.55) exists only after three other problems the records owe are resolved (CO-6 entry with fee, consultation fee for appointment 6, goodwill for builder-error CO-4), each a multi-factor calculation over the design ledger plus purchase/lock records. Difficulty comes from reading the prerequisite sentences of the deposit rule, checking the ledger to see they do not hold, finding which write brings each state about, and getting four layered calculations exactly right; tools never refuse or hint.

[Problem-tree card] Root design_ext_option_deposit_due (owner=user tool pay_option_deposit_3846be30, the buyer pays in person). Fan-out of three value_input edges, all state form:
 E1 -> design_ext_change_order_fee, gate order_fees. Sentence: "The option deposit due is fixed only after every change order number carried by an option line on the file has its change order entry on the design ledger." Opening: OPT-LM0326-016 and the removal of OPT-LM0326-008 carry CO-6, entries exist only for CO-1..CO-5. Only record_change_order_fee writes change order entries in this difficulty. Skip effect: root 6315.55 instead of 8443.55.
 E2 -> design_ext_studio_consult_fee, gate studio_fee_lines. Sentence: "The option deposit due is not fixed until every selection appointment held beyond the package's included appointments has its consultation fee line on the file." Opening: selection appointments 1,2,3,4,6 (five) vs three included; only appointment 4 has fee line OPT-LM0326-015. Only book_studio_consult_fee writes consultation fee lines. Skip effect: 8068.55.
 E3 -> design_ext_error_goodwill_credit, gate credit_offset. Sentence: "The option deposit due is worked out only once every error-correcting change order on the file carries its builder goodwill credit memo." Opening: CO-3 and CO-4 are builder_error, only DCM-3188 (CO-3) exists. Only grant_goodwill_credit writes builder goodwill grants. Skip effect: 8730.20.
 Four-point test per sentence: explicit connective (only after / not until / only once; two affirmative, one negated, chosen as a desk would state when a figure is final); record-visible state named in ledger words (change order entry, consultation fee line, goodwill credit memo); no tool, id or code token; scope exact (every change order number / every appointment beyond included / every error-correcting change order). Derivation: sentence + ledger (missing CO-6 entry, unbilled appointment 6, CO-4 without memo) + each depended-on rule ("Every set of option lines added or removed under a change order number is recorded as one change order entry carrying its fee"; "A selection appointment held beyond the package's included appointments is billed with one consultation fee line"; "Every change order written to correct a design studio or builder error is compensated with one builder goodwill credit") -> exactly one write each. Topological order: the three prerequisites (any order) then the root; all six orders replayed to the same terminal hash. value_input edges: 3 (needs >= 2). The persona mentions none of the prerequisites; tools validate none.

[Base-invariant card] Step 7 design_change_orders.change_order_state: file status structural_closed (initial_state design_selections) is in [in_selection, structural_closed]. Step 9 design_credits: no gate on design_credit_granted -> policy_scope; the extended overwrite replaces the goodwill cap sentence with the goodwill room. Step 11 design_option_selection.open_for_changes (structural_closed allowed) and price_protection (time: anchor appointment 6 event_date 2026-09-24, 45 calendar days Studio Designer, counting from the next day, inclusive, ends 2026-11-08; frozen 2026-10-06 inside; just-fail 2026-11-09); design_package_eligibility, design_appointments, design_change_orders, design_option_deposits policy_scope. Step 13 design_option_deposits.deposit_deadline (time: anchor OPT-LM0326-016 event_date 2026-09-30 Wednesday, 5 business days from Thursday: Oct 1, 2, 5, 6, 7; frozen 2026-10-06 is day 4; just-fail 2026-10-08).

[Business-object card] Target file c-file (design_selections, Studio Designer) of agreement LM-0326. CO-6 = rows with change_order_number CO-6 (add OPT-LM0326-016 5640.00 cabinetry; removal of OPT-LM0326-008 credit 1776.00); excluded: CO-1..CO-5 already recorded. Goodwill object = CO-4 (removed OPT-LM0326-007 6480.00, replacement OPT-LM0326-013 2840.00); CO-3 is settled by DCM-3188 (500.00, applied to OPT-LM0326-012). Consultation fee object = appointment 6 (video, 6.0 h, 2026-09-24); appointment 4 settled by OPT-LM0326-015; the electrical walk (seq 5) is not a selection appointment. Deposit object = the whole file's deposit position, payment posted against OPT-LM0326-016.

[Factor card, figures from the Step 5 run]
 change order fee 2128.00 (all-baseline 450.00): schedule_fee_stage framing -> 1425.00 (baseline 958.00); change_percent 10% (1860.00); change_amount_measure like-for-like 2680.00 (2246.40); paid_order_multiple 1.5 (1558.00); lead_time_surcharge 150.00 (1978.00); studio_error_relief 20% (2555.50). Near-miss: CO-5 lines (flooring, 1860.00) are a different change order and do not count toward CO-6's amount or surcharge.
 goodwill 910.00 (all-baseline 0): error_amount_basis 3640.00 (1000.00); entry_channel_and_age 20% for 49 days studio entry (364.00); affiliated_financing_points 5 (728.00, lock locked, cross-difficulty lock); repeat_error_multiple 2 (250.00); build_slip_addition 250.00 for a 14-day slip (500.00, cross-difficulty purchase). Near-miss: CO-3 also builder_error but already compensated, it counts for the multiple and the goodwill already granted, not as the object.
 consultation fee 375.00 (all-baseline 250.00): appointment_channel_rate video over hours 80% (468.75); build_stage_rate 52 days after start 150% (250.00, cross-difficulty purchase); billed_fee_count 2 (187.50); repeat_visit_multiple 1.25 (300.00); order_relief_rate 50% (750.00, multi-source date+amount). Near-miss: the electrical walk (seq 5, 1.5 h) is not a selection appointment.
 option deposit due 8443.55 (all-baseline 0, the baseline deposit is below deposits held): structural_stage_percent 100% (377.30, cross-difficulty purchase); returned_payment_finish_percent 35% (6002.75); long_lead_percent 100% (5144.15); long_lead_credit_rule: replaced long-lead item, credit deducted from neither group (6845.15); credit_offset_method all credit 7410.00 (8730.20); lender_relief 10% (11749.25, multi-source financing+lock). Near-miss: cabinetry OPT-LM0326-004 and countertops OPT-LM0326-012 were added before construction start and stay in the finish group; the ladder threshold (75000.00) and option cap (116818.20) do not bind at option total 60446.25.
 Multi-source factors: entry_channel_and_age, affiliated_financing_points, order_relief_rate, lender_relief, change_percent, schedule_fee_stage. Cross-difficulty: purchase (stage, start date, completion dates, financing) and lock (status).

[Seed rows] customers (identity), purchase_agreements (stage framing, start 2026-08-03, completion dates, financing calloway_home_mortgage, base price 648990.00), rate_locks (270-Day Build Lock locked), design_selections (balances equal ledger sums), 41 design_events: 6 appointments, 16 option/fee lines, 3 removals, 5 change order entries, 5 payments + 1 return, 2 grants, 3 applications. Removing appointment 6 or the CO-6 rows or the CO-4 entry collapses an edge; removing the return changes the finish percent; removing the lock changes points and relief. No automatic clause fires: the file is not at drywall (stage framing), no closing, no cancellation, deposit deadline not passed.

[Persona] Brisk pharmacist, volunteers only the goal (pay the option deposit she owes, by ACH from checking, herself, today) and the island swap she signed; identity only when asked; agrees passively if told something must be recorded first; runs the payment tool once with the values read to her; closes after the receipt. No number of hers enters gold except her credentials and the payment method.

[Standard solution] Locate by name, verify with DOB + SSN last four, read file, ledger, agreement and rate lock; book CO-6 entry 2128.00; grant goodwill 910.00 for CO-4; book consultation fee 375.00 for appointment 6; hand over the payment tool; buyer pays 8443.55 by ACH against OPT-LM0326-016.

[Verification] /tmp authoring evaluator replays gold with the real tools and evaluates each policy compute at its handling time (check_compute primitives): 2128.0, 910.0, 375.0, 8443.55; per-factor and all-baseline figures as above; prerequisite skips 6315.55 / 8068.55 / 8730.20; six permutations of the prerequisites give one terminal hash. Gates run per task: see the closing line below.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the deposit rule's three prerequisite sentences and the ledger alone, a reader sees CO-6 without an entry, appointment 6 unbilled, CO-4 without memo; the change order, consultation fee and goodwill rules each name their entry and figure; recomputing in prose gives the same 2128.00 / 375.00 / 910.00 and then 8443.55. No second reading found: the replaced-item share and credit offset rules each select one method on these records.

[Revisions] r1: consultation fee line dated today made the latest change order number None for a later change order fee computation (order dependence). Root cause: LATEST by date. Change: the fee tool dates the line on its appointment date. Re-run: all orders identical.

 r2: task 1 introduced the returned payment fee rule; the opening return of RCPT-DS-30942 was moved to 2026-07-06 so the booked 35.00 fee line is exactly what that rule gives (3 days after posting, first return, slow replacement). The change order rule now identifies the change order whose lines were added or removed most recently (a removal-only change order in task 1). Re-run: 2128.00 / 910.00 / 375.00 / 8443.55 unchanged; new terminal hash a907b96e74165a498a5629b095040614e865dc0b33bab608acbc757bcd9552d1 for all six orders.
 r3 (closing): task 1 finally claimed returned payment fee lines, package allowance returns for removed lines and the buyer's reinstatement of a removed line; package changes, cancellation refunds and card fee lines stayed unclaimed by design (no record-determined computation for a buyer-chosen target). The difficulty's seven policies are split 4 / 3 with disjoint tools.
[Gates, run from the repository root] per task 0 and final: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK; SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (suite means branches 57.00, steps 13.50; history_rows_max 84; branches_max 75); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO (optional). TRACEABILITY NOT OK only because the KB is not yet rendered: the unlocked tool names have no published source yet; every other argument traced.

[Rework round 2 — response to audits/policy_task/design_studio_changes (0.md, _difficulty.md)]
 F1 (deposit: one removal credit fitting both the finish group and the long-lead group). Symptom: 8443.55 vs 7884.11. Root cause: the finish group said "less the removal credits booked on those lines" while the long-lead sentence also claimed credits booked at foundation or framing. Change: the rule now defines "the long-lead removal credits" (removal credits booked on cabinetry and countertop lines while the stage was foundation or framing, whenever the lines were added), excludes them from the finish group by name ("less the removal credits booked on those lines other than the long-lead removal credits, less any long-lead removal credits sent to it") and lets one long-lead credit rule place them. Compute gains long_lead_credit_to_finish; finish_group subtracts it. Re-run: scored values unchanged; the literal two-group reading no longer exists because the rule states where the credit goes.
 F3 (replaced_item_share labelled method but a share). Change: replaced by factor long_lead_credit_rule (method), whose three tiers select where the long-lead removal credits are deducted: neither group (replaced item, group = added lines), the finish group (no long-lead line added), or the long-lead group (standard). The share parameter unreplaced_share was removed. Sensitivity unchanged (6845.15).
 O1: the change order rule now says an error-correcting change order is recorded at 0.00 under the builder-error waiver and is not priced by this rule, so the rule's domain equals compute's (buyer-requested orders). O2: recorded, no change (fee lines are dated on their appointment or return date and carry no change order number; in neither world is a fee line the latest addition). O3: the vacuous structural_closed + not_started tier was removed and the stage complete added to every framing-or-later list (change order fee, deposit structural percent, reinstatement re-order surcharge, allowance return share). O4: no half-cent intermediate exists in any scored chain of either world (checked in the Step 5 runs), so half-even vs half-up never decides a figure. O5: kept as method (three different ledger bases). O6/O8: inherited base behaviour, no change. O9: the consult order relief now reads "the option lines added under that change order total". O10: realism notes kept; historical goodwill DCM-3188 (500.00) is consistent because estimated completion equalled contract completion before construction started (no slip addition then) and the room was 500.00 with a single error change order.
user_scenario:
You are Theresa Lindqvist, 40, a hospital pharmacist buying a new Calloway home in Larkspur Meadows in Castle Rock, Colorado (lot LM-0326, The Ridgecrest - Elevation C). You are organised and a little brisk, you call on your lunch break, and you like clear numbers. You are calling the Homebuyer and Warranty Services desk about your design studio file. Last week, on September 30, you signed the paperwork that swaps your kitchen island for the waterfall quartz island you picked with your designer, and you want to pay whatever option deposit you now owe on your design file today, so nothing holds up your cabinets. You will pay it yourself, by ACH from my checking account as you put it, and you do not want to pay by card. You do not know what the amount should be: you have no statement in front of you, only your own selection sheet, and you expect the representative to work it out from Calloway's records.

When you are asked who you are, you give your full name, Theresa Lindqvist. When you are asked to confirm your identity, you give your date of birth, March 14, 1986 (1986-03-14), and the last four digits of your Social Security number, 5318. Only if the representative asks for something more do you add your mobile number, 720-555-0152 (7205550152), or your ZIP code, 80104. If you are asked which home or file this is, you say it is lot LM-0326 in Larkspur Meadows, the Ridgecrest plan, financed through Calloway Home Mortgage. You do not bring up anything else about your file; if the representative asks about its history, you say the studio has all of that on file and you would rather they go by the records.

If the representative explains that something has to be recorded or settled on your design file before the deposit figure is final, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead, without asking for details. If the representative tells you an amount, you accept it as Calloway's figure; you do not argue it and you never suggest a number of your own. When the representative hands you the payment tool, you run it once yourself, exactly as instructed, using the file reference number and the option line number the representative reads to you, the amount the representative states, and ACH as the payment method. You do not pay by card or check, and you do not split the payment.

Once the payment has gone through, you read back the receipt number it shows, say thank you and end the call. If the representative tells you no deposit is owed after all, you thank them and end the call without paying.
